game_concept: A strategy race set in Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter, a smelter processing glowing ore: the lava scout must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Ore Smelter open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter: a smelter processing glowing ore
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Read value for station 8, then display the same value without changing it. Test dataset 8: {'value': -8}; {'value': 24}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ore Smelter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the fire shrine by solving code steps involving gates_open that move the lava scout forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the fire shrine first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
